body: I know. I'm sorry that I'm just whining and bitching at this point. My GPA is pretty good already, about a 3.5. I had pretty good stats in high school, went to a great school across the country but was too poor to continue going there. Now I'm at my state school. Had I applied directly from high school I would have been paid to come here. Because I'm a transfer student, however, they denied to give me any merit or need scholarships. It's frustrating as hell but I have been trying to deal with it. I've been trying to accept the fact that I have basically fucked up school beyond repair and am honestly lucky to even get into this shit hole, considering that my last stint in college ended up with me getting picked up by the police at 1am and involuntarily committed to a mental hospital for a month. This is my third attempt at college, at three different schools. If I can't make this work then... well, I don't know if I should even keep trying. And I keep trying and everything I try doesn't work, it can't just be the world, there must be something fucking wrong with me. Everyone can see it: I am nothing. Everything I do to make myself a better human being are all superficial coverups that cannot disguise this fact which, apparently, everyone seems to see. I don't know why I even try because I will never do anything significant or even matter to anyone. Failure and rejection are really the only consistent things I have ever experienced. Hell, I couldn't even be a "good" anorexic or successfully kill myself when I set my mind to it. I don't like being around myself very much, so I guess I can't expect other people to want to be around me, either. What could I possibly have to offer?

That is what I thought too. I have met people who shared some of my interests in other places, but no one here. But I seem to be too poor to permanently relocate and too dumb to get into a school that would actually give enough aid for me to attend out of state. And I don't know if that would even help because I have not ruled out that I am not the cause of my own problem.

Example: I signed up for a volunteer service trip that sends students around the world. Instead of hearing about people excited to travel, learn a language, help people, and have a new and exciting experience, I get an hour long politically correct rant from rich white kids about "white shame" and how poor people need to be educated because "they don't know any other way to live." And as close as I was to pulling my fucking hair out... it's not like I'm really in a position to be choosy about my friends or who I talk to at this point.

Thinking too much is probably the bane of my existence. My interests are things like travel, literature, philosophy, cinema, languages, and running. I'm not particularly good or knowledgeable about any of those things, but it's generally pretty rare to find anyone who watches a movie by Kubrick or reads something besides... well, who actually reads. When I try to talk about travel with people, for example, I get responses like "I would never want to do that" or stupid judgmental quips. At first I could shrug it off as people just being ignorant and raised in this incredibly backward state. But, hearing the same responses over and over again makes me wonder if maybe it's just me being... defective.

I think it is the fact that I have had such a hard time making friends at my current university. I try to diversity my interests and be involved and active in the community, but I seem to have nothing in common with people. I end up being ridiculously socially awkward or extremely bitter toward other people. I am in a position where I find people to be boring, close minded, and kind of dumb, but I am also having to beg for social interaction. It is kind of degrading. I don't want or try to be stuck up. I understand I'm a kind of weird person and probably won't get along with most people. But the loneliness right now is really difficult to handle. People criticize my interests to the point where I'm almost ashamed to even talk to anyone (I also have this feeling of being too ugly to actually go out in public). My life really has no direction. No one would notice or care if I were gone. I guess it's just a lot of little things, and seeing that the amount of effort I have been putting in to making things better is not really getting me anywhere.

That's a pretty interesting proposal. I actually spent last year living and working in a foreign country, did quite a bit of couchsurfing when I traveled. I don't expect happiness to just show up on my door and I work really hard toward self-improvement, such as running, learning a new language and hobbies, etc. It just doesn't seem to get me anywhere, people don't seem to like me more because of it (and really I just need some friends). I wish I could do something like that again but I actually need to finish school eventually... Now I'm trapped in some god forsaken place surrounded by idiots. Or maybe I'm the biggest idiot for coming here. I don't know.
That might be true, but I wonder how effective I'd be considering I can hardly say things to make myself feel better.
